These efforts focus on predictive battery management for electric fleets.

about_short_description.short_description: Zitara Technologies is a company that offers predictive battery management software for electric fleets.

product.name: Zitara Power
product.description: An on-premise algorithm that processes cell-level voltage, current, and temperature data to produce accurate real-time battery control signals such as State of Power and State of Charge.

product.name: Zitara Balance
product.description: An on-premise algorithm that analyzes cell-level data to provide real-time balance and imbalance signals at the rack level, prioritizing balancing activities to reduce downtime.

product.name: Zitara Insight
product.description: A service analyzing historical battery production data to identify control signal errors, rack imbalances, and safety issues, providing actionable reports for asset optimization.

product.name: Zitara Studio
product.description: A simulation and modeling tool that provides validated battery testing and predictive modeling to forecast battery performance under various conditions.
